name: The Standard, Miami
insider_take: This iconic South Beach stunner sits right on the bay with unobstructed views of downtown Miami's glittering skyline – it's where minimalist Scandinavian design meets Miami's electric energy.
whats_special: The hotel features the famous infinity pool that appears to spill directly into Biscayne Bay, plus the rooftop spa offers treatments in glass-walled rooms with panoramic water views. The lobby's floor-to-ceiling windows frame the bay like living artwork, and you're steps from both Lincoln Road's shopping and the Art Deco Historic District.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on floors 8-12 for the best skyline vistas, especially stunning at sunset when downtown Miami lights up across the water.
dont_miss: The Lido Bayside Grill's weekend brunch with bottomless mimosas overlooking the marina, and catch the complimentary sunset yoga sessions on the pool deck – pure Miami magic with that skyline backdrop.
pros: Prime Biscayne Bay waterfront location with stunning bay views
Vibrant rooftop pool and spa with panoramic Miami skyline views
Distinctive modern design with floor-to-ceiling windows
Lido Bayside Grill offering waterfront dining experience
cons: Located on quieter bay side rather than ocean beachfront
Contemporary minimalist style may not suit all preferences
